Who is it for? Healthcare professionals and other personnel who need BLS/CPR for healthcare providers. Prerequisites None. What students get at the end BLS certification meeting the Dental Board's live, in-person skills and written exam requirement. BLS certification must be renewed every 2 years. Price $85*. Duration 3 hours. Format Instructor-led course with classroom instruction, live skills practice, skills testing, and a written exam. The academy also notes a blended HeartCode BLS option with online learning followed by an in-person skills evaluation. Class date(s) June 6, 2026 (Full); July 18, 2026; August 1, 2026; September 5, 2026; October 3, 2026; November 7, 2026; December 5, 2026.
